verdict.rationale: Meta's docs say Llama 3.1 adds "function calling and agent-optimized inference", and the llama-models CLI can show a model's prompt format, so the core capability exists. The evidence never describes typed tool schemas, parallel calls, or multi-step agent loops. The developer docs sit behind an SSO wall for anonymous readers, which undercuts "documented well enough". Missing for 10: typed tool-definition documentation, parallel tool-call support, multi-step agent-loop guidance, publicly readable docs, independent/hands-on corroboration of tool-call faithfulness.
